name: Ha Long sea-mussel porridge
summary: Cháo trai Hạ Long is rice porridge with sea mussels, finished with green onion, cilantro, fried shallot, and fried dough.
origin: Hạ Long. This is the sea-clam porridge, not the freshwater cháo trai of Hanoi.
howToEat: Ground rice cooked with trai biển. Eat it with hành lá, mùi tàu, hành khô, and quẩy.
where: Chợ Hạ Long 1 and chợ Hạ Long 2.
priceBand: About 15,000–20,000 đồng a bowl with the quẩy, at chợ Hạ Long 1 and 2 (16 Mar 2021). Current price: Check on arrival.
